notes.description: Gamma function has poles at non-positive integers. Strict mode returns NaN; Hardened mode returns error.
notes.mitigation: Domain validation in Hardened mode. Strict mode NaN propagation matches SciPy behavior.

notes.description: J0/J1 use rational polynomial approximation (Numerical Recipes). Accuracy is ~1e-8 near x=0 due to coefficient precision limits.
notes.mitigation: Tolerances set to 1e-8 for bessel boundary checks. Higher-precision coefficients can be substituted.

notes.description: erfinv is only defined on (-1, 1). Values at ±1 produce ±Inf, values outside produce NaN in Strict mode.
notes.mitigation: Hardened mode rejects out-of-domain inputs. E2E tests cover boundary and out-of-domain cases.

notes.description: Incomplete gamma uses series/continued fraction expansion. Convergence can be slow for large a or x.
notes.mitigation: Complement identity P+Q=1 verified in parity gates. Series truncation monitored by iteration count.
